missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics to confirm the timeout originates at redis rather than the inventory client
Logs from inventory and redis services for the incident window
candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in the inventory service, causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to return 503, which propagates through order to gateway checkout as 502s. Traces show redis.reserve_inventory STATUS_CODE_ERROR with error.type=timeout and DependencyUnavailable across multiple correlation IDs.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side saturation vs network/client timeout not distinguished; logs excluded from context.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout returns 502 with ~2s durations. Traces consistently show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts causing inventory 503s that propagate to order and gateway. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Metrics show checkout 502s and elevated p95 latency. Root cause bounded to redis-timeout; redis-side confirmation pending.
